  • Machines/cables. 2020: machines for advanced lifters only, he is biased against them, no machines in his program (Fierce 5 novice program review (from an hypertrophy standpoint), 2020-02; 5 days Upper Lower program review (part. 2), 2020-10; Free 3 times a week full body hypertrophy program, 2020-01). 2023-24: machine shoulder press S tier, cable laterals best, he moved most triceps work to cables/Smith, and machines let you train hard (The ULTIMATE Shoulder Exercises Tier-List (Boulder-tier to Pebble-tier), 2023-02; So you think you look good? (Physique Critique Chad Edition), 2024-12; I am officially obese (Hypertrophy Log #7), 2024-08).
  • Leg extensions and leg curls. 2020-21: leg extensions are subpar and knee-risky; prefer hinges over curls (Coolcicada 6 Days PPL Program review, 2020-05; Jeff Nippard's Push Pull Legs program review, 2021-01). 2023: leg extensions Platz tier, lying leg curl S tier (The ULTIMATE Quads/Legs Exercises Tier-List (Platz-tier to Chicken-tier), 2023-07; The ULTIMATE Legs/Hamstrings Exercises Tier-List (Horse-tier to Polio-tier), 2023-04).
  • Specificity. 2020-21: must be respected; the tree of specificity governs selection (The hypertrophy series： using lifting rotations to maximize quality tonnage, 2020-05; Minimalist training bad, 2021-06). 2023-24: C tier, "not important for bodybuilding" (The Most IMPORTANT Methods for Muscle Growth (Hypertrophy Tier-List), 2023-11; The WORST Bodybuilding Program Ever Created (my bad), 2024-04).
  • Overhead press. 2020: a big fan of barbell OHP (3 days Upper 2 days Lower program review (for an advanced calisthenics guy part., 2020-11). 2024: "plateau machine"; he dropped it for a Smith 80° incline press (Your lifting program SUCKS! (Hypertrophy Q&A / Program review), 2024-10; So you think you look good? (Physique Critique Chad Edition), 2024-12).
  • Push-ups. 2020: too easy for advanced lifters (The hypertrophy series： strength baseline control for recovery & gains, 2020-05). 2022-24: not only for novices; he regrets dropping them (My TOP 3 Calisthenics Chest Exercises (Exotic Push-Ups For Muscle Growth), 2022-01; The WORST Bodybuilding Program Ever Created (my bad), 2024-04).
  • JM press. 2020: disliked as an elbow-unfriendly hybrid (5 days Upper Lower program review (part. 1), 2020-10). 2022-24: excellent and elbow-saving (The ULTIMATE Triceps Exercises Tier-List (Mythical-tier to Toothpick-tier), 2022-10; Everything I do to get HUGE (Split, Reps, Lifts), 2023-09).
  • Hip thrusts. 2022-23: fine add-on, S tier (Get your GF in the Gym (Girl Fitness Program), 2022-06; The ULTIMATE Legs/Hamstrings Exercises Tier-List (Horse-tier to Polio-tier), 2023-04). 2024: dislikes them as redundant (Your lifting program SUCKS! (Hypertrophy Q&A / Program review), 2024-10; So you think you can lift? (Program Review LIVE), 2024-11).
  • Pendlay rows. 2020: good for strength and size (Response to Husaka - CHEST - Bench vs Ring Push Ups, 2020-03). 2022-24: mediocre for lats, not a good hypertrophy movement (The ULTIMATE Back/Lats Exercises Tier-List (Yujiro-tier to Peewee-tier), 2022-11; So you think you can lift? (Program Review LIVE), 2024-11).
  • Calisthenics/rings. 2020: rings have a poor technicality-to-hypertrophy ratio (Hypertrophy Q&A #1, 2020-09). 2024: calisthenics for the upper body plus free weights for legs is the ideal, and how he trains (This Calisthenics Freak Makes Bodybuilders Look Small (Baki_HD), 2024-06).
  • Pull-up volume. 2020: "you can never do too many pull-ups" (FREE 4 days split for intermediates (Upper Lower Fullbody Fullbody), 2020-03). 2023: his old novice program had too many; now fewer, weighted (ULTIMATE HYPERTROPHY PROGRAMS (Novice to Advanced), 2023-06).
  • Leg extensions are also contradicted inside 2020 (no extensions needed vs accept if you like them). This is treated as tolerance, not a change (FREE 4 days split for intermediates (Upper Lower Fullbody Fullbody), 2020-03; 3 days PPL program review, 2020-06).

Contradictions

  • Rotation scheduling. 2020: rotations "should always be scheduled, not done by feel" (Rotating lifts： What it should & shouldn't be, 2020-05). 2022: rotations should never be scheduled (e.g. every two weeks) or triggered by a plateau, only "when the muscle needs it" (Why I never deload (and why you shouldn't either), 2022-02). 2023: scheduled for most people, autoregulated for advanced lifters (How to Keep Growing FOREVER (Unlimited Hypertrophy Method), 2023-07), which may reconcile the two.
  • Barbell rows in his programs. 2021: "none of his programs, novice or otherwise, include barbell rows" (Why Novices shouldn't do Barbell Rows, 2021-08). Yet many templates include them: swimming template rows 3x8-10 (Lifting plans for Athletes (programming for sports), 2021-09), barbell/seal rows 4x8-12 (The PERFECT Hybrid Calisthenics Program (Feat Bald Omni Man), 2023-01), 2023 barbell rows as the day's hinge (Come with me if you want a BIG BACK (4 steps MASSterplan), 2023-09).
  • Leg curls/isolation for his own legs. 2023-24 he rates the lying leg curl S tier and the leg extension Platz tier (The ULTIMATE Legs/Hamstrings Exercises Tier-List (Horse-tier to Polio-tier), 2023-04; The ULTIMATE Quads/Legs Exercises Tier-List (Platz-tier to Chicken-tier), 2023-07). But in 2024 he trains legs only with free weights and hip hinges "despite evidence" (New hypertrophy study just dropped (And Basically You're F＊cking Stupid), 2024-01). Same year, his staples include belt squats and Smith work (The WORST Bodybuilding Program Ever Created (my bad), 2024-04; 20 inch arms CMON (Hypertrophy Log #9), 2024-12).
  • Importance of exercise selection. 2021: "exercise selection dictates how your physique turns out, so it is paramount" (The Hypertrophy Iceberg Explained (a complete guide to muscle growth), 2021-07). Also 2021: for naturals "exercise selection is a by-product" of programming (3 steps to follow for Bigger Arms, 2021-02). 2023: only B tier (The Most IMPORTANT Methods for Muscle Growth (Hypertrophy Tier-List), 2023-11).
  • Band curls. "Mediocre, use for recovery" (The ULTIMATE Biceps Exercises Tier-List (Arnold-tier to Noodle-tier), 2022-10) vs "excellent, the only curl he really feels" (Do you look better than Silver Era lifters? (Physique Review LIVE), 2024-12).
  • Pullovers for chest. "Best complement to the bench" and a chest/lat builder (Top 3 most underrated exercises, 2021-07; Farnese Hercules Bodybuilding Program (Ancient Greek Herculean Physique Workout), 2022-03) vs "mediocre for chest" and "not a chest lift" (The ULTIMATE Chest Exercises Tier-List (Gorilla-tier to A cup-tier), 2022-12; Exercise Tier Lists are STUPID, 2024-11).
  • Leg press. 2021: dislikes it, causes lower back pain (Viking's the Bare Bones Series Program review, 2021-03) vs 2022/2024: a fine leg builder and the pick for people with lower back problems (Greek Aesthetics Bodybuilding Program (Apollonian Physique Workout), 2022-05; Your lifting program SUCKS! (Hypertrophy Q&A / Program review), 2024-10).
  • Seal vs Pendlay rows. Seal rows are among the best rows (5 days Upper Lower program review (Week 2), 2020-08) vs he prefers Pendlay and hates a chest pad (Hypertrophy Q&A #10, 2022-06).
  • Kroc rows. Slightly inferior to DB rows, explosive without negative control (The ULTIMATE Back/Lats Exercises Tier-List (Yujiro-tier to Peewee-tier), 2022-11) vs "incredibly underrated, unmatched for traps" (So you think you can lift? (Program Review LIVE), 2024-11). These may just be different muscles judged (lats vs traps).

Fatigue deload

Changed over time

  • Wording on "never deload" refined. In 2020 he said he never deloads ( (The training principles series： deloads, 2020-06)). By 2022 he clarified that he deloads constantly through set/rep management, just not the powerlifter way ( (Jeff Nippard & Alec Enkiri Want Me To Deload... I Don't Wanna (Size vs Strength , 2022-03)). Later view: deloading is built in.
  • Form of an acceptable deload. In 2020 the "objectively better deload" was usual lifts at low intensity and volume ( (The training principles series： deloads, 2020-06)). In 2024 he said even an active deload far from failure is wasted for hypertrophy ( (Why everyone HATES Paul Carter (liftrunbang1), 2024-02)), yet in a separate 2024 video he called 2 sets at 2 RIR reasonable ( (So you think you can lift? (Program Review LIVE), 2024-11)). Later stance: harder against it, with that one exception.
  • SFR downgraded. In 2022 he treated it as a simple valid concept ( (Biomechanics Gurus™ need to 𝚂𝙷𝚄𝚃 𝚄𝙿 about Optimal Training, 2022-10)). He ranked it B tier in 2023 ( (The Most IMPORTANT Methods for Muscle Growth (Hypertrophy Tier-List), 2023-11)) and 5th, "an excuse", in 2024 ( (Exercise Tier Lists are STUPID, 2024-11)).
  • His own lower-body recovery. In 2022 he trained legs every two days ( (Superhero Aesthetics Bodybuilding Program (Kinobody Hollywood Physique Workout), 2022-08)). In 2025 he said he needs ~72 h because recovery lags as strength rises ( (New Hypertrophy Gimmick™ just dropped 🤡, 2025-03)). Later view: 72 h.

Contradictions

  • Is feel a valid gauge? In 2020 he said how you feel during and the day after a workout means nothing for judging volume ( (Hypertrophy Q&A #2, 2020-10)). The same year he said to judge extra tonnage by sensations and soreness 4 days later ( (The hypertrophy series： maintaining tonnage stability for long term progress, 2020-05)) and to "let your body be the judge" for CNS ( (Hypertrophy Q&A #4, 2020-12)).
  • Is overtraining real? In 2020 he called it real ( (The training principles series： overtraining, 2020-02)) and also "a myth" ( (Hypertrophy Q&A #3, 2020-11)). He also said most people needn't worry about muscular fatigue ( (The hypertrophy series： stimulus to fatigue ratio, 2020-06)) but that most who think they overtrain are right ( (Hypertrophy Q&A #1, 2020-09)).
  • Day-to-day interference. In 2022 he said deadlift Monday then barbell rows Tuesday won't work ( (Hypertrophy Q&A #10, 2022-06)). In 2024 he said lats to failure then RDLs the next day doesn't hurt him, and doubted that one day's training hurts the next (garbled; (BACK 2 THE GYM STREAM (Program reviews & Answering training questions), 2024-09)).

Fitness industry

Changed over time

  • Monetisation and coaching. Earlier: he would never monetise, never write programs on request or sell programs (2020). Coaching is a scam ~99% of the time (2020). "If he ever sells a paid program, unsubscribe" (2021) (FREE 4/5 days Gentleman split (part. 1), 2020-10; RANT： You don't need a coach, 2020-02; Natural Bodybuilding is dead, but we can revive it, 2021-02). Still in Sept 2024 he refused to coach (1st Natural Hypertrophy stream! ASK YOUR QUESTIONS AND I SHALL ANSWER, 2024-09). Later: Ko-fi donations (2023), then Ko-fi memberships plus a coaching/teaching service from Dec 2024, and the "strategist" tier in 2025 with custom programs. He frames it as teaching independence and accepts some criticism as warranted (Let's put a cutie under your 🎄 (Dating / Relationships Q&A), 2024-12; RIP Natural Hypertrophy; Welcome School of Strategy!, 2025-01; Community post (1 year ago, approx date), 2025-10; Ko-fi page (captured 2026-10-20), 2026-10). The later view is the current one. YouTube itself stays unmonetised.
  • Main PED problem. 2020-2022: fake naturals are the enemy (My opinion on Pro Bodybuilding, 2021-01). 2022-2025: PED "honesty" made use mainstream, and by 2025 honest enhanced influencers are the main problem (Mike Israetel's DANGEROUS steroid advice, 2022-08; 💉 Taking steroids is cheating ｜ Natural Bodybuilder Reacts 💪, 2025-01).
  • Natty-or-not videos. 2020: he won't make them, but they help newcomers learn natural limits (Natty or not (.com)： Eric Bugenhagen, 2020-05). 2021-2024: they help nobody and "produce nothing good" (Natural Bodybuilding is dead, but we can revive it, 2021-02; 10 Signs you might be a Blackpilled Natty, 2024-04).
  • Science-based channels. 2021: he predicts they'll lose traction (The Galaxy Brains of YT Fitness have ruined science, 2021-01). 2022: Nippard is the best programming channel and the current era may be YouTube fitness's best for creator quality (Judging and Grading every Fitness Channel (ⅠⅠ： Jeff Nippard, Eric Bugenhagen, 2022-04; My channel was deleted, but...I AM BACK! (A Great Victory Against Censorship...T, 2022-02). 2024: he wants a middle ground and calls Nippard decent, while criticising the science-based community's dogmatism (Jeff Nippard assaulted by steroid loser Mike Van Wyck, 2024-10; The Hypocrisy of Science-Based Lifters, 2024-12). This is a refinement rather than a reversal.

Contradictions

  • Naming people. He says criticise practices, not people, asks permission before naming anyone, and won't do natty-or-not on individuals (Fake Merc Character Study (part. 5)： Moody Dick, 2020-11; Response to Steve Shaw (Massive Iron) - Going to WAR Over FRONT DELT training, 2020-03; Natty or not (.com)： Eric Bugenhagen, 2020-05). Yet he ran long named series on Blaha and Nether and publicly graded dozens of named creators (Fake Merc Character Study (part. 20)： To coath a Predator, 2022-05; Judging and Grading every Fitness Channel (Ⅰ： Greg Doucette, AlphaDestiny, Rya, 2022-04). His stated exception is people he considers dangerous (Censorship on Youtube： How Greg Doucette betrayed the entire Fitness community b, 2021-05).
  • Insult styles. The "daddy-talk" insulting style is exploitative (The Brainlets of YT Fitness don't understand Science, 2021-02; Judging and Grading every Fitness Channel (Ⅰ： Greg Doucette, AlphaDestiny, Rya, 2022-04), versus "insulting obese people into action can work" (Judging and Grading every Fitness Channel (Ⅰ： Greg Doucette, AlphaDestiny, Rya, 2022-04). He also deliberately offends viewers to break parasocial bonds (Fanboyism is a mental illness： How Youtubers steal your identity through parasoc, 2021-04).
  • Buying programs. "Paying for a program is a waste" and "stop buying programs" (Free novice program for hypertrophy, 2020-02; The WORST Bodybuilding Program Ever Created (my bad), 2024-04), versus recommending specific paid programs as worth it (Jeff Nippard & Minimalism： Working Hard or Hardly Working?, 2022-10; Judging and Grading every Fitness Channel (VI： Liver King, Alex Eubank, Jujimufu, 2022-12).
  • Physique as credential. "Being bigger is not an argument" (science_evidence) and "experience isn't how a physique looks" (Judging and Grading every Fitness Channel (Ⅰ： Greg Doucette, AlphaDestiny, Rya, 2022-04), versus "don't take hypertrophy advice from small people" (Therapy is CANCELLED (Jung ｜ Modern Man in Search of a Soul), 2024-11). He reconciles these via the halo-effect caveat and his natural-only rule.

Frequency split

Changed over time

  • His own split. 2020-2023: 6 days/week on an 8-day rotation of themed day pairs, Sunday off, so a full cycle takes 9 days (My sets/frequency for Natural Hypertrophy, 2020-01; FREE 4 days Body Parts split for Intermediates, 2020-06; My Program to go BERSERKER MODE (BODYBUILDING GOAL PHYSIQUE), 2022-06; Everything I do to get HUGE (Split, Reps, Lifts), 2023-09). 2024-03: upper/lower 6x/week (Everything I eat to get HUGE (Full Bulking Plan), 2024-03). 2024-09: went from 7 to 6 to 5 days: 3 upper (2 torso, 1 arms) + 2 lower (Bodybuilding is killing me (Hypertrophy Log #8), 2024-09; BACK 2 THE GYM STREAM (Program reviews & Answering training questions), 2024-09). 2024-12: upper 3x, lower 2x (20 inch arms CMON (Hypertrophy Log #9), 2024-12). 2025-01: 3 home + 2 commercial gym sessions + 2 backyard carry sessions (You know what time it is... STORY TIME, 2025-01). Later view: fewer, harder days.
  • Frequency vs intensity. 2021-2022: frequency and duration beat intensity, and trading frequency for intensity is "questionable" (ANIME WORKOUTS - Can you train like a Baki character? A Grappler Baki Training G, 2021-06; Mike Mentzer： Mustachioed fraud or Bodybuilding genius? (🆃🅷🅴 🅷🅸, 2022-08; How to Get Bigger by Doing Less (The 85% Rule), 2022-12). 2023: stronger lifters need longer recovery windows, and he trains high-frequency because he cannot produce the per-session intensity Alex can (The Hardworking Lifter who BROKE the Natty Limit (Alex Leonidas), 2023-05). 2024: "never sacrifice intensity for frequency", while sacrificing frequency for intensity is fine. Training less often lets him train harder with unchanged gains (How I Built Monster Legs, 2024-12; Bodybuilding is killing me (Hypertrophy Log #8), 2024-09). Later view: intensity is protected first.
  • Leg frequency. 2020-2024-05: legs every 48 h / 3x/week, and once a week is terrible (How I utilize body part splits for maximum muscle hypertrophy (versus upper lowe, 2020-01; This is Peak Bulk (Hypertrophy Log #6), 2024-05). 2023-2024: Alex's legs grow on 1x/week, and legs 1x/week is fine while fixing an upper weakness (The Hardworking Lifter who BROKE the Natty Limit (Alex Leonidas), 2023-05; So you think you can lift? (Program Review LIVE), 2024-11). 2024-12: he trains legs 2x/week with 72-96 h between sessions, because 3x/week becomes unrecoverable at ~400s squat / ~500s RDL (How I Built Monster Legs, 2024-12; How I Built Monster Legs, 2024-12). Later view: 2x/week for strong advanced lifters.
  • Full body. 2020: "not a big fan", it rarely digs deep per muscle and most people slap compounds together (FREE 4 days split for intermediates (Upper Lower Fullbody Fullbody), 2020-03; How to program a Gentleman split, 2020-10; The issue with HIT (the intensity meme), 2020-11), though 3x/week has a good fatigue ratio (ANIME WORKOUTS - Can you look like Baki Hanma in real life?, 2020-10). 2023-2024: "full-body splits are good splits", 3x/week is "one of the best templates" and 2x/week is excellent for busy lifters (Bodybuilder Roasts AI Generated Program 👨‍💻, 2023-01; Your lifting program SUCKS! (Hypertrophy Q&A / Program review), 2024-10; Your lifting program SUCKS! (Hypertrophy Q&A / Program review), 2024-10). Later view: positive.
  • PPL. 2020: standard PPL is the worst order and lower-biased, and its core flaw is why he promoted body-part splits (Coolcicada 6 Days PPL Program review, 2020-05; Coolcicada 6 Days PPL Program review, 2020-05). 2023-2024: PPL's bad reputation is unwarranted and it is a very good split (still in pull-push-legs order) (The ULTIMATE PPL Program (Doom Slayer Physique), 2023-11; So you think you look good? (Physique Critique Chad Edition), 2024-12). Later view: positive.
  • "Body-part split" label. 2020: a well-built body-part split is the smartest and best natural template (How I split up my week for Natural Hypertrophy, 2020-01; Body parts split： bro split vs Gentleman Split, 2020-09). 2021-2023: body-part splits are "the worst template for gaining muscle" and push you into junk volume to justify the session (Analyzing the Rock's ＂Black Adam＂ training program, 2021-03; Analyzing Chris Bumstead's training program, 2021-08; The Natty Arnold? (Joel Kellett aka Overkell), 2023-07). The underlying idea (synergistic multi-muscle days at 2x/week) stayed the same under the name "gentleman split". The change is mostly terminology.
  • Back days. 2020: the back is the one muscle where a bro-split day makes sense (huge tonnage from many angles) (6 days french bodybuilding split review, 2020-07). 2022-2024: never have a back day, cap 3 exercises per day and spread back volume (Level up your back, 2022-02; Does Mr. Olympia know how to train BACK? (Analyzing Chris Bumstead's Workout w/ , 2022-10; Judging and Grading every Fitness Channel (Sam Sulek, Max Euceda, Lex Little), 2024-01). Later view: no back day.
  • Triceps extensions supersetted with presses. 2020 recommended: long-head triceps work between press back-off sets does not hurt pressing (FREE 4 days Body Parts split for Intermediates, 2020-06; FREE 4 days Body Parts split for Intermediates, 2020-06). 2024: he no longer believes in it, and the pairing appears only in his old programs (BACK 2 THE GYM STREAM (Program reviews & Answering training questions), 2024-09).
  • Deadlift frequency for himself. 2020-01: floor pulls every 4 days (My sets/frequency for Natural Hypertrophy, 2020-01). 2020-03: heavy conventional every 8 days (Who can afford to only squat and deadlift once a week?, 2020-03). 2020-12: heavy deadlift 2x/week (Using the lower back as a bridge (the new lift with your legs), 2020-12). 2022: heavy hinge every 2 days, and a bodybuilder needs it only every 2-3 days (𝙃𝙊𝙍𝙍𝙄𝙁𝙄𝘾 𝙡𝙞𝙛𝙩𝙞𝙣𝙜 𝙞𝙣𝙟𝙪, 2022-08; 3 YEARS WITHOUT INJURIES： How I bulletproofed myself (and how you can do it too), 2022-06). 2023-2024: advises cutting deadlifts to 1x/week (at most 2) (This is why you don't have a Demon Back (Advanced Tips), 2023-11; Why everyone HATES Paul Carter (liftrunbang1), 2024-02). Later advice: the deadlift proper ~1x/week, with hinge variations more often.

Contradictions

  • Deadlift frequency (same period). In 2020-12 he says deadlift "only a few times a month, never every two days" (How to do deadlifts for SIZE, 2020-12) and also reports heavy deadlifts twice a week (Using the lower back as a bridge (the new lift with your legs), 2020-12). In 2022 he hinges heavy every 2 days (How to do squats for SIZE, 2022-09). Partly reconciled by deadlift vs hinge variations, but not fully.
  • Back & biceps pairing. 2020: back day always involves biceps and forearms, so back and biceps "fits naturally" (6 days Body parts split program review, 2020-08). Same year and later: low synergy, and an arm day is better (Coolcicada 6 Days PPL Program review, 2020-05; Level up your back, 2022-02; Bodybuilder Roasts AI Generated Program 👨‍💻, 2023-01). He also pairs lats with biceps after weighted chins (2023) (This is why you don't have a Demon Back (Advanced Tips), 2023-11).
  • Chest and upper back on the same day. 2020: do not put chest and upper back on the same upper day (Hypertrophy Q&A #1, 2020-09). Elsewhere: superset chest with upper back on upper days, and chest and back are fine antagonists to pair (Candito Upper Lower Hypertrophy Program review, 2020-05; How the King of Zoomers Trains to Look like a Greek God (Alex Eubank Program Rev, 2022-12; 5 days Upper Lower program review (Week 2), 2020-08).
  • Training back every day. 2022/2024: back can be trained every session or every day if parts are rotated (Does Mr. Olympia know how to train BACK? (Analyzing Chris Bumstead's Workout w/ , 2022-10; So you think you can lift? (Program Review LIVE), 2024-11). 2023: "never train back every day", and one back exercise six days a week is a bad idea (Come with me if you want a BIG BACK (4 steps MASSterplan), 2023-09; Come with me if you want a BIG BACK (4 steps MASSterplan), 2023-09).
  • Same muscle on consecutive days. 2020-04: he never trains the same muscle two days in a row (48 h protein synthesis) (The hypertrophy series： maximum recoverable volume, 2020-04), and 2024 calls 48 h a bare minimum (So you think you look good? (Physique Critique Chad Edition), 2024-12). But 2020 and 2022: two days in a row is valid, and so is 90/80/70% Mon-Wed (5 Ways to shock the muscle (GONE WRONG), 2020-07; Why I never deload (and why you shouldn't either), 2022-02). A plausible reconciliation is hard vs light hits, but he does not always state it.
  • Heavy/light day structures. He rejects heavy/light and volume/intensity days (7 days split program review (Rubgy focus), 2020-07; Upper Lower Light/Heavy 4 days split with mirror Week program review (part. 2), 2020-12; The hypertrophy series： modulating session timeframe to control volume/intensity, 2020-08), yet he describes gentleman days as heavy/moderate/pump (Body parts split： bro split vs Gentleman Split, 2020-09), recommends heavy/medium/light full body for intermediates (Fullbody template review, 2021-01), and suggests alternating strength weeks with giant-set weeks (5 days Upper Lower program review (part. 2), 2020-10).
  • Full body days per week. 2021: 4 days is the sweet spot, and 2x cannot accumulate enough volume (Fullbody template review, 2021-01; Fullbody template review, 2021-01). 2023: 2 not enough, 3 perfect, 4 too much (The Best Natural Lifter You've NEVER Heard Of (Hersovyac), 2023-04). 2024: 2x/week is excellent for busy lifters (Your lifting program SUCKS! (Hypertrophy Q&A / Program review), 2024-10).
  • Where legs go in a full-body session. 2021: train legs last so presses have energy (The Silver Era Hercules： Steve Reeves (Legends of the Past), 2021-12). 2023: start with legs, they are most taxing (The Natty FREAK with Superhero Aesthetics (Bald Omni-Man), 2023-06).
  • Upper work on lower days. 2020: he dislikes hammer curls, pushdowns and triceps extensions on lower days, because they turn the day into a body-part split (4 days Upper Lower program review, 2020-06). Elsewhere: add upper-back, arm and isolation work to lower days, and "rigid splits are mostly idiotic" (How to structure a Gentleman split (volume & intensity), 2020-12; My Program to go BERSERKER MODE (BODYBUILDING GOAL PHYSIQUE), 2022-06; 1st Natural Hypertrophy stream! ASK YOUR QUESTIONS AND I SHALL ANSWER, 2024-09).
  • Upper/lower verdict, 2020. "Upper/lower is the best skeleton" (How to program a Gentleman split, 2020-10) vs he dislikes upper/lower because lower days cram squats and deadlifts together (FREE 4 days split for intermediates (Upper Lower Fullbody Fullbody), 2020-03).
  • Arm day order. 2021: curls and extensions first when freshest (3 steps to follow for Bigger Arms, 2021-02). 2020/2023: open with a heavy compound (Want big arms? Get an arm day, 2020-01; We're turning Alan Thrall into a bodybuilder!, 2023-05).
  • Arm day next to upper days. 2020: arm day "won't take away" from strength and can sit between heavy days or on rest days (How to program an arm day (the Natural Hypertrophy example), 2020-01). A 2020 template puts a horizontal press on arm day (FREE 4/5 days Gentleman split (part. 2), 2020-10), while 2021/2023 say never put arm days next to or between upper days (Good arm day Vs Bad arm day, 2021-01; The Monster Natty that trains EVERY DAY (Geoffrey Verity Schofield), 2023-04). The second pair is about adjacency to upper days, so this is partly compatible.

Genetics potential

Changed over time

  • How much he credits genetics: 2020 says genetics "won't be treated as an important factor" on his channel and are irrelevant to reaching potential (What having bad genetics means (to me), 2020-04; What having bad genetics means (to me), 2020-04). In 2024-25 he openly ranks lifters on a 1-10 scale, tells roommate stories as "proof genetics exist", and says "a 5 can only achieve what a 5 can" (Why you shouldn't listen to Genetic Freaks (The Joel Williams Example), 2024-02; Story Time (Top 10 NH stories), 2024-12; 💉 Taking steroids is cheating ｜ Natural Bodybuilder Reacts 💪, 2025-01). Later view: genetics set the ceiling and speed, but still are no excuse.
  • Natural limit: 2020-23 says there is no limit, you "progress until you die", and limits exist only if you believe them (The Educated Barbarian： Hagakure analysis (part. 5), 2020-08; RANT： Discipline & work ethic are NOT genetic traits!, 2020-05; The Hardworking Lifter who BROKE the Natty Limit (Alex Leonidas), 2023-05). 2024: limits exist but you can't locate them, so be "delusional" and keep training (Your standards are too low., 2024-12). Later view = refined.
  • Self-rating: 2020 "bad" or "bottom-of-the-barrel" genetics, with 8 in 10 people better (10 Year Natural Transformation 15-25 (from 110 to 210 lbs), 2020-04; The Educated Barbarian： Hagakure analysis (part. 14), 2020-10); 2024 "5/10, roughly average" (Your standards are too low., 2024-12). Later view = average.
  • Minimum time before judging genetics: 1 year (2021-22) (Swole shaming is real, BIGot, 2021-03; You are the flea in the mayonnaise jar (GENETICS RANT), 2022-04) → 10 years (2023) (5 Secrets of Elite Natural Lifters, 2023-10).

Contradictions

  • Is natural potential unlimited? "Effectively unlimited" and "almost infinite" (Lifting natty is a waste of time, 2022-09; Why you will NEVER have freaky, thick forearms if your wrists are small (Natty o, 2021-02) vs "not infinite or equal to enhanced; 270 lb at 5% impossible" (My opinion on Pro Bodybuilding, 2021-01) (both 2021-22).
  • Can everyone achieve it? "No person on Earth lacks the ability to build a good physique" (You are the flea in the mayonnaise jar (GENETICS RANT), 2022-04) vs "telling everyone they can achieve anything is an insult to people who lack what it takes" (Judging and Grading every Fitness Channel (ⅠⅠⅠ： AthleanX, Kinobody, Scott , 2022-05) (both 2022).
  • Hard gainers: "hard gainers do not exist" (Natty or not (.com)： Alpha Destiny, 2020-07) vs truly cursed lifters "exist but are rare" and a true hardgainer has a hormonal handicap (Tales of Genetics： Lifting Anomalies, 2021-06; 5 diet tips for hardgainers, 2020-06). This is mostly a difference of degree.
  • Tall lifters' speed: "may progress faster thanks to absolute strength" (Advice to look thick for tall/wide lifters (best practices & mindset), 2020-09) vs "need more time to build muscle naturally" (Generation Aesthetics： Zyzz, the Godfather of Terrible Role Models, 2021-12). Reconciled in 2024 as strength gains at the same speed, visual change slower (Your lifting program SUCKS! (Hypertrophy Q&A / Program review), 2024-10).

Injuries

Changed over time

  • Pain handling: absolutist → graded. 2020: "never lift through pain; if a movement hurts, stop" (How to work around pain, 2020-01; Tips to combat shoulder pain, 2020-02). 2021: graded occurrence/aftermath scales, with minor pain to be pushed aside, nocebo awareness, and level-2 pain where you may push through (Did I just snap my sh＊t up? (an injury assessment guide & pain psychology discus, 2021-09; Did I just snap my sh＊t up? (an injury assessment guide & pain psychology discus, 2021-09). Later (2022-2025) he still treats tendon/joint pain as a stop signal (3 YEARS WITHOUT INJURIES： How I bulletproofed myself (and how you can do it too), 2022-06; 10 years of lifting for this (Hypertrophy Log #10), 2025-01). The later view is graded, but the stop rule still holds for tendons.
  • Front delts and shoulder health. 2020: front-delt isolation instead of pressing fixed his shoulders, and a strong front delt prevents injury (Response to Steve Shaw (Massive Iron) - Going to WAR Over FRONT DELT training, 2020-03; Response to Steve Shaw (Massive Iron) - Going to WAR Over FRONT DELT training, 2020-03; Response to Steve Shaw (Massive Iron) - Going to WAR Over FRONT DELT training, 2020-03). 2022: overdeveloped front delts versus weak rear/side delts invite injury; he shrank his front delts, built rear delts/traps, and the injuries stopped (𝙃𝙊𝙍𝙍𝙄𝙁𝙄𝘾 𝙡𝙞𝙛𝙩𝙞𝙣𝙜 𝙞𝙣𝙟𝙪, 2022-08). The 2022 view is later; both agree that rear delts matter.
  • Dips and shoulders. 2020: dips are usually worse than bench for bad shoulders, ring dips "double the risk" (Program critique #1 (Upper Lower Push Pull), 2020-02; Hypertrophy Q&A #2, 2020-10). 2023-2024: avoiding dips while doubling down on bench is where shoulder injuries happen, and dips help shoulders (I was WRONG about these lifts, 2023-12; Do you look better than Silver Era lifters? (Physique Review LIVE), 2024-12). The later view is pro-dip.
  • Close-grip bench. 2020: a shoulder-friendly swap (3×6-10) that "repeats well" (Boring but Big program review, 2020-11; 5 days Upper Lower (2 Uppers 2 Lowers + 1 Arm day) program review, 2020-10). 2023: he dropped it after it gave him elbow tendinitis and posterior shoulder pain (Everything I do to get HUGE (Split, Reps, Lifts), 2023-09; Wild Man Training (Hypertrophy Log #0), 2023-06).
  • Bench press itself. 2020-2022: kept benching via Slingshot/paused/Spoto (Should you buy this instead of a slingshot? (Bench daddy review), 2020-01; The ULTIMATE Chest Exercises Tier-List (Gorilla-tier to A cup-tier), 2022-12). 2024: he dropped (flat-back, full-range) bench because it destroyed his shoulders (Do you look better than Silver Era lifters? (Physique Review LIVE), 2024-12).
  • Warm-up volume. 2020: long warm-ups (empty bar + 25-30 reps; knees 35-40 min) (The training principles series： warming up & stretching, 2020-04; How I program my Squat days for Natural Hypertrophy, 2020-02). 2025: 1-2 sets are enough for tendons (10 years of lifting for this (Hypertrophy Log #10), 2025-01). This is a refinement and may reflect different contexts.
  • Pullover reps. 2020-2021: ≥6 (Injury Q&A #1, 2020-08; Injury Q&A #4, 2021-06). 2022: 8-12 (Silver Era Aesthetics Program (Steve Reeves Physique Workout), 2022-10). A refinement upward.
  • Causes of tendinitis. 2020-2021: movement and lifestyle stress, with stress possibly the main factor (Curing patellar tendinitis (part. 1)： Causes & symptoms, 2020-05; When Snap City occurs, 2021-03). Late 2021: diet inflammation only minor, movement matters far more (TENDINITIS, BEGONE! (Healing Tendinopathy / Tendon Pain Rehab for Lifters), 2021-11).

Contradictions

  • What fixed his knees: big quads or posterior chain? 2020-2021: growing his quads (~23 in), "not glutes or hamstrings", cured his patellar tendinitis, and the quads protect the tendon (Response to Steve Shaw (Massive Iron) - Going to WAR Over FRONT DELT training, 2020-03; Injury Q&A #4, 2021-06; Curing patellar tendinitis (part. 2)： Rehab & precautions, 2020-05). 2020: big quads relative to posterior chain cause his knee problems (How I program my Squat days for Natural Hypertrophy, 2020-02). 2022: relearning the squat and building big hamstrings and glutes fixed his knee pain (𝙃𝙊𝙍𝙍𝙄𝙁𝙄𝘾 𝙡𝙞𝙛𝙩𝙞𝙣𝙜 𝙞𝙣𝙟𝙪, 2022-08).
  • Biceps low reps. 2020-09: very experienced lifters can carefully do 3-5 (How to start using evolving rep ranges in your training, 2020-09). 2020-11: no 2-5 rep ranges for biceps (Synchronizing evolving rep range with movement patterns, variations & rotations , 2020-11).
  • Zero injuries vs acceptable injuries. Smart naturals won't get sudden injuries, and 10 years with zero injuries should be possible (Serious injuries don't just ＂happen＂, 2020-01; When Snap City occurs, 2021-03). But: "pushing the limits will sometimes injure you; that is acceptable" (Keep Ronnie Coleman's name out of your unworthy hardgainer's mouth, 2021-07).
  • Behind-the-head pressing. 2020: behind-the-neck pressing is bad for the shoulder (What really happens when you injure your shoulder, 2020-02). 2021: the behind-the-head snatch-grip press is a valid hypertrophy variation, just never heavy if unconditioned (FREE Bodybuilding Split (Olympic Weightlifter Physique edition), 2021-10).
  • Tendon training. 2020-2024: strength restoration and the JM press target and build tendons (Strength restoration strategies, 2020-09; I was WRONG about these lifts, 2023-12). 2023: direct tendon training is a waste of time for aesthetics (The Streetlifting MUTANT w/ Steel Cable Tendons (Artem Shirokov), 2023-12). These are partly reconcilable, since rehab and aesthetics have different goals.
  • Neutral grip. 2020: neutral-grip DB pressing wrecks his shoulders and neutral curls/pulls can overextend the rotator cuff (Injury Q&A #1, 2020-08; 5 days Upper Lower program review (Week 1), 2020-07). Yet he lists neutral grip as a fix for elbow pain on pull-ups (So you think you can lift? (Program Review LIVE), 2024-11; How to do pull-ups to maximize muscle growth and minimize injury risks, 2021-09).
  • Icing timing. He says to wait 2-3 h after leg training (Curing patellar tendinitis (part. 3)： Recovery hacks & supplements, 2020-06), but also to ice ~10-15 min after training (1st Natural Hypertrophy stream! ASK YOUR QUESTIONS AND I SHALL ANSWER, 2024-09). The 2024 phrasing is ambiguous.

Intensity failure

Changed over time

  • Failure on every working set → selective failure. 2020: every working set goes to failure, "no point not going to failure" (The hypertrophy series： the importance of going to failure for muscle building, 2020-05; Hypertrophy Q&A #2, 2020-10), though even then compounds kept a rep in the tank (Rep Goal System (by Steve Shaw of Massive Iron) review, 2020-07). From 2022: failure on everything misallocates resources, "always training to failure is stupid", proximity is the point; failure only on isolation and upper body (3 YEARS WITHOUT INJURIES： How I bulletproofed myself (and how you can do it too), 2022-06; The Most IMPORTANT Methods for Muscle Growth (Hypertrophy Tier-List), 2023-11; How to Get Bigger by Doing Less (The 85% Rule), 2022-12; 1st Natural Hypertrophy stream! ASK YOUR QUESTIONS AND I SHALL ANSWER, 2024-09). Later view: selective.
  • RIR size on lower-body compounds. 2020-11: exactly 1 RIR, never 2 or more (The hypertrophy series： applying reps in reserve while minimizing tonnage loss, 2020-11). 2022-2024: 2 RIR on squats/deadlifts/SSB squats, 1-2 RIR on hinges (𝙃𝙊𝙍𝙍𝙄𝙁𝙄𝘾 𝙡𝙞𝙛𝙩𝙞𝙣𝙜 𝙞𝙣𝙟𝙪, 2022-08; We're turning Alan Thrall into a bodybuilder!, 2023-05; Bodybuilding is killing me (Hypertrophy Log #8), 2024-09). Later view: 1-2 (often 2).
  • Rest-pause. 2020-21: skeptical, ranked last, leaks tonnage, a disguised three sets (5 Ways to shock the muscle (GONE WRONG), 2020-07; Doggcrapp Training review, 2021-01). 2023-25: his favourite technique, preferred over drop sets, worth +10-50% hyper-intense volume (Arnold trained like an idiot?, 2024-04; 20 inch arms CMON (Hypertrophy Log #9), 2024-12; 10 years of lifting for this (Hypertrophy Log #10), 2025-01). Later view: pro rest-pause.
  • Upper rep limit. 2020-02: 20-35 reps as the upper limit (Transcendent training review (from an hypertrophy standpoint), 2020-02). 2020-09: ~15 (How to start doing more volume in your training, 2020-09). 2022-12: 15-20 extremes (How to Get Bigger by Doing Less (The 85% Rule), 2022-12). 2024: "never 20+", all work 3-15 (1st Natural Hypertrophy stream! ASK YOUR QUESTIONS AND I SHALL ANSWER, 2024-09; Do you look better than Silver Era lifters? (Physique Review LIVE), 2024-12). 2025 adds that true failure is reachable at 12-15 (New Hypertrophy Gimmick™ just dropped 🤡, 2025-03).
  • Personal skew from volume to intensity. 2020-21: he loves volume, doesn't respond well to intensity, calls himself volume-skewed (Wisconsin method aka Bulgarian light review (from a muscular hypertrophy standpo, 2020-02; The Recovery Pot Explained (a complete guide to muscle recuperation), 2021-02). 2023-24: intensity drives growth and volume is a last resort; "these days intensity" (Come with me if you want a BIG BACK (4 steps MASSterplan), 2023-09; Time to become indestructible (Self-Improvement Q&A), 2024-10).
  • Hip thrusts. 2020: never to failure (5 days Upper Lower program review (Week 1), 2020-07). 2022: failure is safe, as long as ROM isn't cut (🦍 Get Gorilla Glutes (Best 𝙢𝘼𝙎𝙎 Building Exercises), 2022-09).
  • Mentzer/HIT tone. 2020: HIT is a cult (Hypertrophy Q&A #3, 2020-11). 2022-24: keep Mentzer's hard-set understanding; Mentzer was right on intensity but went too far (Mike Mentzer： Mustachioed fraud or Bodybuilding genius? (🆃🅷🅴 🅷🅸, 2022-08; BACK 2 THE GYM STREAM (Program reviews & Answering training questions), 2024-09).
  • AMRAP. 2020: he does pull-ups as AMRAPs and likes it (Program critique #1 (Upper Lower Push Pull), 2020-02). 2021: AMRAPs only for finishers and unweighted calisthenics (Hypertrophy Q&A #8, 2021-09). 2024: drop AMRAP sets from bodybuilding programs (So you think you can lift? (Program Review LIVE), 2024-11), although bodyweight pull-up AMRAPs still appear in 2023 (Come with me if you want a BIG BACK (4 steps MASSterplan), 2023-09).

Contradictions

  • RIR on compounds: sandbagging or smart? He keeps 1-2 RIR on squats and hinges (We're turning Alan Thrall into a bodybuilder!, 2023-05; 1st Natural Hypertrophy stream! ASK YOUR QUESTIONS AND I SHALL ANSWER, 2024-09), yet says leaving strength reps in reserve is a strength-athlete tool and bodybuilders who sandbag "train for strength" (The Great MOGGING of Bodybuilding： How Strength Came to DOMINATE Fitness, 2022-02), and that progressing 4-6 with RIR "is just sandbagging" (New Hypertrophy Gimmick™ just dropped 🤡, 2025-03). The 2025 remark targets low-rep HIT-style work, but the tension isn't resolved.
  • Percentages vs no percentages. He recommends % of an estimated 1RM over RPE (The Hypertrophy Iceberg Explained (a complete guide to muscle growth), 2021-07; No one understands training intensity, 2021-11), but also says "no percentages, push every set to failure" (FREE 4 days Upper Lower sheiko inspired Bodybuilding Program, 2020-09), that he dislikes percentages (When are you intermediate and what it means programming wise (for bodybuilding), 2020-02), and that he doesn't know his own 1RM (The hypertrophy series： volume vs intensity, 2020-04).
  • Heavy/medium/light days. He dislikes light/heavy days and volume/intensity days (Upper Lower Light/Heavy 4 days split with mirror Week program review (part. 1), 2020-12; Hypertrophy Q&A #6, 2021-03), but full body "needs heavy, medium and light days for each muscle" (Fullbody template review, 2021-01). Possibly split-dependent.
  • Steady vs swinging intensity. "Steady 85-95% beats swinging between 99% and 60%" (The hypertrophy series： deloading without wasting tonnage, 2020-12) vs "intensity can swing (95% one day, 65% the next)" around an 85% average (How to Get Bigger by Doing Less (The 85% Rule), 2022-12).
  • Can intensity exceed 100%? No; forced reps only shift the window (Hypertrophy Q&A #3, 2020-11). Yes, via overloads like high block pulls (The hypertrophy series： nucleus overload vs junk volume, 2020-10).
  • NO and failure. NO at ~15% "still reaches muscular failure" (Nucleus overload guide (part. 4)： Reps, sets and frequency schemes, 2020-10) vs "never reach failure on NO, always ≥5 reps left" (☣️ Biohacking Muscle Growth with Nucleus Overload 💪, 2022-03).
  • Meaning of "mechanical failure". In 2020-21 it is structural breakdown that doesn't count as failure (The hypertrophy series： the importance of going to failure for muscle building, 2020-05; The Hypertrophy Iceberg Explained (a complete guide to muscle growth), 2021-07). In 2023 he "defines failure as mechanical failure", meaning stop when body English appears (SAVAGE PUSH DAY 🔥 (Hypertrophy Log #3), 2023-07). Elsewhere it also means pump/lactic "artificial" failure (The hypertrophy series： bypassing muscular endurance thresholds, 2021-01). This is a terminology clash, not a change of substance.
  • Flies to failure. Avoid ranges that push flies to mechanical failure; failure there is pointless and risky (6 days french bodybuilding split review, 2020-07) vs flies with loads "to failure and beyond" (𝐄𝐗𝐏𝐋𝐎𝐃𝐄 your Chest Gains (3 𝐊𝐈𝐋𝐋𝐄𝐑 Pec Ex, 2022-11) and cable flies safe to push to failure (Push/Pull Pull/Legs Legs/Push 3 days program review, 2020-05).
  • One set vs many. One-set trainees are lazy (Hypertrophy Q&A #3, 2020-11) vs one hard low-rep set can replace three chest exercises with better results (Analyzing the Rock's ＂Black Adam＂ training program, 2021-03; The hypertrophy series： the optimal number of sets for muscle growth, 2021-02).
  • Grinding. Grinding drains and injures; never grind (Why you should leave reps in the tank (Reps in Reserve), 2020-02; The hypertrophy series： mechanical vs muscular fatigue, 2020-06) vs grinding is where the muscle works hardest and good lifts let you grind (I was WRONG about these lifts, 2023-12; Why you should STOP doing incline curls, 2023-02). Likely compounds vs isolations, but he never states that.
  • Back-off loads. He uses reduced-weight back-off sets (Arnold trained like an idiot?, 2024-04), but also says he never takes weight off the bar because that is regression (Why I never deload (and why you shouldn't either), 2022-02).

Life philosophy

Changed over time

  • Stoicism. 2020: "the philosophy he most identifies with" day to day, practised without the label (The Educated Barbarian： Meditations analysis (part. 1), 2020-12; Natural Q&A #4, 2020-11). 2021: "not a Stoic", dropped the Discourses and moved to Nietzsche and Jung (The Next Educated Barbarian Cycle, 2021-10; How to lead a happy life (The Educated Barbarian： Seneca analysis, part. 1), 2021-08). 2022-23: Stoicism "shames instincts", is a self-imposed tyranny and an Apollonian brake on passionate men (God is 🅳🅴🅰🅳 and so are you： Mankind's Fall from Grace into a Faithle, 2022-04; Stoicism： A Philosophy for Idiots, 2023-10). 2024: still the recommended entry point (TIME TO GROW BOYS (Live Q&A / Self-Improvement), 2024-09). Later view: a useful starter philosophy that is critically qualified.
  • Anger and emotion. 2020: leave aggression at the gym, wrath is a capital sin, master and repress your urges in your 20s (Seven Deadly Fitness Sins： Wrath, 2020-04; Natural Q&A #3, 2020-10). 2022-24: embrace anger that fuels the will; repressed emotion explodes; emotional concealment is men's #1 problem; the full emotional range is masculine (Natural Q&A #9, 2022-01; Time to become indestructible (Self-Improvement Q&A), 2024-10; You are not Guts (The Berserk Trauma), 2023-10; Therapy is CANCELLED (Jung ｜ Modern Man in Search of a Soul), 2024-11). Later view: experience and channel emotion rather than suppress it.
  • Religious identity. 2020-22: baptised, non-practising Catholic who follows the New Testament and considers himself Christian (Natural Q&A #4, 2020-11; Natural Q&A #7, 2021-05; Natural Q&A #9, 2022-01). 2024-25: "not religious but spiritual", agnostic (POV： Your therapist is a bodybuilder (Jung, ＂Modern Man in Search of a Soul＂), 2024-10; TIME TO GROW BOYS (Live Q&A / Self-Improvement), 2024-09; You know what time it is... STORY TIME, 2025-01).
  • Work and passion. 2020-21: "work is happiness", two weeks off make him miserable, fulfilling work stops feeling like work (Pull Push Legs 6 days Program Review, 2020-05; Natural Q&A #7, 2021-05; The Educated Barbarian： Meditations analysis (part. 17), 2021-04). 2022-24: don't seek fulfilment in your job, it is an obligation, and never monetise your passion (I WON! Japanese Boomers on 🅷🅰🆁🅰🅺🅸🆁🅸 Watch (Victory Q&A), 2022-09; TIME TO GROW BOYS (Live Q&A / Self-Improvement), 2024-09; Let's put a cutie under your 🎄 (Dating / Relationships Q&A), 2024-12). Self-employment followed a similar path: 2022 he preferred clocking out at 5 PM as an employee (I WON! Japanese Boomers on 🅷🅰🆁🅰🅺🅸🆁🅸 Watch (Victory Q&A), 2022-09); 2023 he would rather work for his audience than the corporate world (Community post (3 years ago, approx date), 2023-10); 2025 he launched paid lessons (RIP Natural Hypertrophy; Welcome School of Strategy!, 2025-01).
  • Nihilism. 2020: read positively ("since we all die, be at ease with it"; "true nihilism" gives meaning back) (The Educated Barbarian： Hagakure analysis (part. 2), 2020-07; The Educated Barbarian： Hagakure analysis (part. 16), 2020-10). 2021-22: nihilism is self-destructive and "the most abject limitation", and atheism as belief in nothing is worse than believing something wrong (A History of Human Greed & Dark Tournaments (YuYu Hakusho analysis), 2021-08; NO LIMITS ｜ Pearls of Wisdom from Devon Larratt, 2022-07; God is 🅳🅴🅰🅳 and so are you： Mankind's Fall from Grace into a Faithle, 2022-04).
  • Status of the body. 2020: the body is "the lesser part" and an envelope; "you are not your body" (The Educated Barbarian： Book of Five Rings analysis (part. 4), 2020-05; The Educated Barbarian： Meditations analysis (part. 2), 2020-12). 2021-23: body and soul are one coin, put the body at the centre, and mind-body dualism is the error (Baki Hanma wants YOU to love your muscles, 2021-02; Medieval Lifting Wisdom, 2022-04; Are you too smart to lift?, 2023-01).
  • Source of morality. 2021 Stoic reading cycle: virtue is built into nature, immortal and self-renewing (How to lead a happy life (The Educated Barbarian： Seneca analysis, part. 2), 2021-08; How to lead a happy life (The Educated Barbarian： Seneca analysis, part. 3), 2021-09; The Educated Barbarian： Meditations analysis (part. 18), 2021-04). 2022+ Nietzsche cycle: morality is man-made, not innate, and should be questioned and judged by consequences (💥 This Philosophy has the Power to 𝐃𝐄𝐒𝐓𝐑𝐎𝐘 the World (Mo, 2022-09; Disappointed by Zoomers, 2022-07; Only Fools & Slaves Love Chains： Modern Morality vs Will To Power (Aristocrat Ni, 2022-03). Already in 2020 he held that good and evil don't exist in nature but are socially useful (The Educated Barbarian： Hagakure analysis (part. 9), 2020-09).
  • Casual sex. 2020-21: serial casual dating is immoral and damages both partners (Natural Q&A #3, 2020-10; Generation Aesthetics： Zyzz, the Godfather of Terrible Role Models, 2021-12). 2024: still against hookup culture (Women： Do they even lift? (Dating/Relationships Q&A), 2024-09), but a woman's casual past doesn't damage her, short fun relationships give experience, and "don't be black and white" (How to get buff GF (Dating & Relationships Q&A), 2024-11; How to get buff GF (Dating & Relationships Q&A), 2024-11).
  • Anti-work sentiment. 2020: "rat race" talk is cope; a man pulls his weight (Nether Beast Character Study： De Jesús or Matthew (24_11), 2020-07). 2022: mass quitting is a pendulum swinging back from Industrial-Revolution exploitation, and hustle culture alienates men (I WON! Japanese Boomers on 🅷🅰🆁🅰🅺🅸🆁🅸 Watch (Victory Q&A), 2022-09; 💥 This Philosophy has the Power to 𝐃𝐄𝐒𝐓𝐑𝐎𝐘 the World (Mo, 2022-09; Bodybuilding is 𝐆𝐀𝐘 ? (𝐁𝐑𝐄𝐀𝐊𝐈𝐍𝐆 𝐃𝐎𝐖, 2022-11).

Contradictions

  • AI, in the same 2020 video: AI is "underhyped" because machine knowledge compounds exponentially (Natural Q&A #3, 2020-10), but AI "only does what its programmers taught it" (Natural Q&A #3, 2020-10).
  • Money: 2021, he is detached and hasn't looked at a paycheck in years (Natural Q&A #5, 2021-01). 2024, he cares little about money (TIME TO GROW BOYS (Live Q&A / Self-Improvement), 2024-09), yet money "matters enormously" because living costs have exploded (Let's put a cutie under your 🎄 (Dating / Relationships Q&A), 2024-12).
  • Openness or concealment: be frank and sincere, and say what you mean (The Educated Barbarian： Meditations analysis (part. 9), 2021-02; The Educated Barbarian： Hagakure analysis (part. 21), 2020-12), against "be a closed book" and hide your views (Natural Q&A #8, 2021-10), plus keep a "secret garden" from your wife (❤️ Dating Q&A #1： Leaving the friendzone, Facing rejection, Opening up to gi, 2022-08). Partly reconciled by his mask doctrine, which applies to hostile settings.
  • Men showing emotion: men should cry and express their full emotional range (What Makes a Man? (Toxic Masculinity & Male Power Fantasy in Grappler Baki), 2023-06), while his anecdote and observation say a friend was dumped two days after crying and sad men get cast out (❤️ How to get a girlfriend – A Feminist Chauvinist's opinion on women, lov, 2021-12; You are not Guts (The Berserk Trauma), 2023-10). This is descriptive against normative; he never fully reconciles the two.
  • Casual sex in his own life: he condemns casual sex and says hookups gave him nothing (Natural Q&A #3, 2020-10; Women： Do they even lift? (Dating/Relationships Q&A), 2024-09), but also says he slept with many women who were in long-distance relationships (How to get buff GF (Dating & Relationships Q&A), 2024-11).
    • These are the same idea restated: video-game addiction (2020/2022), health before muscle, obey your own path, love beyond good and evil, individual → collective (three flags), security vs freedom, fatherless society (two flags), kindness requires strength (three flags), biology precedes culture, secular morality vs spirituality, men must cook, fate and worry, science/religion vs his spirituality, fake positivity vs useful negativity, masks, Stoic reading order (Marcus/Epictetus/Seneca vs Seneca/Marcus, which only differ in emphasis).
    • Mindset ranking vs gratitude habit: unrelated.
    • "No one born evil" vs "someone born evil who does good deserves more respect": the second is a hypothetical, so this is mild tension, not a reversal.
    • Casual sex: a partial real refinement, logged under changes.

Mindset

Changed over time

  • Place of the gym in life. 2020-2022: serious lifting means 8-10 h/week that replaces hobbies and social time (Natural Q&A #3, 2020-10). Training should be so central that you "would sooner lose your nails" than stop (Why you will NEVER have freaky, thick forearms if your wrists are small (Natty o, 2021-02). Strip other hobbies so lifting is your one hobby (Medieval Lifting Wisdom, 2022-04), and hobbyists stay mediocre, so make it a lifestyle (FOR THE DIFFICULT ｜ Pearls of Wisdom from Kyriakos Grizzly, 2022-03). 2024 (later view): ~5 h/week with no lifestyle change; don't centre your life on the gym (1st Natural Hypertrophy stream! ASK YOUR QUESTIONS AND I SHALL ANSWER, 2024-09). Gymcelling is a net negative (I was a Gymcel (and it made me miserable), 2024-01), and the gym won't fix your life by itself (Time to become indestructible (Self-Improvement Q&A), 2024-10).
  • Rigidity. 2020-2022: training is rigid, done as planned regardless of feeling, and taking a week off for low motivation is dangerous (Jeff Nippard & Alec Enkiri Want Me To Deload... I Don't Wanna (Size vs Strength , 2022-03). Grad-school paper lists where an undone item counted as failure (TIME TO GROW BOYS (Live Q&A / Self-Improvement), 2024-09). 2024 (later): discipline taken too far is a straitjacket (I was a Gymcel (and it made me miserable), 2024-01), planning every day makes you hyper-rigid (Therapy is CANCELLED (Jung ｜ Modern Man in Search of a Soul), 2024-11), he keeps no rigid time schedule (Time to become indestructible (Self-Improvement Q&A), 2024-10), and willpower fluctuates (🍩 Is Being Fat a Choice? Bodybuilder Reacts 💪, 2024-05).
  • Harshness vs positive reinforcement. 2020-2022: praise breeds stagnation and blame drives growth (𝐁𝐞𝐜𝐨𝐦𝐞 𝐒𝐮𝐩𝐞𝐫𝐡𝐮𝐦𝐚𝐧： Way of the Ü, 2022-08). Lazy people get the mediocre gains they deserve (Are micro workouts really the future of exercise?, 2020-03). He felt pity, not sympathy, for blackpillers (Determination vs determinism - A discussion, 2020-06). 2024 (later): his harsh inner voice turns most people off, and empathy and positive reinforcement work for the majority (🍩 Is Being Fat a Choice? Bodybuilder Reacts 💪, 2024-05). Pure willpower ideology "creates one hero and breaks nine" (🍩 Is Being Fat a Choice? Bodybuilder Reacts 💪, 2024-05). Being average and a happy dad bod are fine (10 Signs you might be a Blackpilled Natty, 2024-04; 🍩 Is Being Fat a Choice? Bodybuilder Reacts 💪, 2024-05).
  • Solitude vs community. 2020-2022: personal development is lonely and company breeds comfort (ANIME WORKOUTS - Would Baki's training really make you gain 20lbs of muscle in t, 2020-09; JUST TRAIN (A Motivational Call to Arms by the Educated Barbarian X Yuyu Hakusho, 2022-02). Destroying a weak identity requires isolation (STORY TIME： How lifting changed my life, 2022-05). 2023-2024 (later): a man's biggest breakthroughs come among other men and the lone-wolf myth is false (What Makes a Man? (Toxic Masculinity & Male Power Fantasy in Grappler Baki), 2023-06). Monk mode makes most people worse, and his own instinct to isolate never helped him (TIME TO GROW BOYS (Live Q&A / Self-Improvement), 2024-09). Seek community (How to get buff GF (Dating & Relationships Q&A), 2024-11).
  • Fuel: dysmorphia and self-hatred vs self-love. 2020: lifting motivation may be an expression of dysmorphia, and you must collaborate with that drive (Jack Hanma's battle against body dysmorphia in Grappler Baki, 2020-11; Jack Hanma's battle against body dysmorphia in Grappler Baki, 2020-11). 2024 (later): self-hatred as fuel works at first then destroys you; love and acceptance kept him going (🍩 Is Being Fat a Choice? Bodybuilder Reacts 💪, 2024-05).
  • Optimism. 2020: "your time will come" is an optimistic mindset that always pays off (The Educated Barbarian： Hagakure analysis (part. 18), 2020-11). 2023 (later): "active pessimism" ranks above active optimism, and optimists shatter when they fail (Become the Hero of Your Own Story (An Essay on Individuality & Helplessness in B, 2023-04; Become the Hero of Your Own Story (An Essay on Individuality & Helplessness in B, 2023-04).
  • Envy. 2020: envy can be a lifelong driving force, a sin only when it turns into resentment (Seven Deadly Fitness Sins： Envy, 2020-07; Seven Deadly Fitness Sins： Envy, 2020-07). 2021-2024 (later): envy is resentment that keeps you from working and is "one of the worst sins"; admiration is the useful version (How to lead a happy life (The Educated Barbarian： Seneca analysis, part. 3), 2021-09; Women： Do they even lift? (Dating/Relationships Q&A), 2024-09).

Contradictions

  • PR focus (both 2024). "Dropping PR culture made him stronger" (The WORST Bodybuilding Program Ever Created (my bad), 2024-04) vs "constant PRs keep him in love with the gym" (This is Peak Bulk (Hypertrophy Log #6), 2024-05). Possibly 1RM obsession vs rep PRs, but he doesn't say so.
  • Gym failure (both 2020). Never actually fail, because repeated failures build a loser's mindset (The hypertrophy series： applying reps in reserve while minimizing tonnage loss, 2020-11) vs a lifter who failed 5 times en route to 300 lb handles misses far better than one who never failed (The Educated Barbarian： Hagakure analysis (part. 18), 2020-11).
  • Comparison. Comparison is the thief of joy; don't compare (The Educated Barbarian： Meditations analysis (part. 20), 2021-05; 💉 Taking steroids is cheating ｜ Natural Bodybuilder Reacts 💪, 2025-01) vs comparison and competition (mogging) are healthy motivators (FOR THE DIFFICULT ｜ Pearls of Wisdom from Kyriakos Grizzly, 2022-03), and surround yourself with better people (You know what time it is... STORY TIME, 2025-01).
  • Goals. Have a clear, detailed goal body (How to body measurements & discussing my weak points, 2020-02; The Hypertrophy Iceberg Explained (a complete guide to muscle growth), 2021-07) vs don't start with a definite physique goal, just train and see (Natural Q&A #4, 2020-11).
  • Announcing goals. Verbalise goals and say them aloud; verbal commitment raises follow-through (The Educated Barbarian： Hagakure analysis (part. 6), 2020-08; The Educated Barbarian： Hagakure analysis (part. 11), 2020-09; 5 Secrets of Elite Natural Lifters, 2023-10) vs don't announce your discipline; loud announcers lack internal willpower (The Educated Barbarian： Hagakure analysis (part. 17), 2020-11; The Educated Barbarian： An introduction to Stoicism (Enchiridion analysis part. , 2021-08).
  • Motivation's weight. Motivation is "the most important half", you just need method too (Judging and Grading every Fitness Channel (ⅠⅠ： Jeff Nippard, Eric Bugenhagen, 2022-04) vs motivation is too unreliable to carry you (Make training fun again, 2021-05; Alpha Male Routines are making me 𝐒𝐈𝐂𝐊, 2022-12).
  • Instinct. Listen to instinct when a style feels right (How your childhood & personality can influence your fitness goals & training, 2020-02), and drop what you instinctively know isn't needed (4 days Upper Lower split Program review, 2020-04), vs instinctive training is rolling dice and lazy (Your instinct WILL fail you (or why programming your training is essential), 2021-12; Your instinct WILL fail you (or why programming your training is essential), 2021-12).
  • Mirror. Stop obsessing in the mirror (Lifting/training with scoliosis, 2021-04) vs train in front of mirrors for a "mirror mood boost" (The Perfect Man： Eugen Sandow (Legends of the Past), 2022-04).
  • Decisions. Decide within seven breaths (The Educated Barbarian： Hagakure analysis (part. 10), 2020-09) vs he never acts on first instinct and sleeps on decisions (1st Natural Hypertrophy stream! ASK YOUR QUESTIONS AND I SHALL ANSWER, 2024-09).

Muscle specific

Changed over time

  • Ab training: daily high volume → weighted, progressive, a few times a week. 2020-2022: abs daily, 60-100 leg-raise reps a day, "heavy abs does nothing", train them like calves (My philosophy regarding abs training, 2020-03; READ THE F＊CKING STICKY - The Best Lifting Advice on 4chan /fit/ (Myths & Minds, 2022-01). 2023-2024: weighted sit-ups 6-12, 3x8-12 progressive overload instead of daily 4x25, 2-4x/week (Heavy Duty Arm Day (Hypertrophy Log #1), 2023-07; Arnold trained like an idiot?, 2024-04; Bodybuilding is killing me (Hypertrophy Log #8), 2024-09). The later view is current.
  • Obliques: unnecessary → S-tier side bends and twists. 2020-2021: twisting work unnecessary; oblique isolation rarely works (5 days Upper Lower program review (part. 1), 2020-10; Hypertrophy Q&A #6, 2021-03). 2023-2024: side bends are S-tier, plus twists and suitcase deadlifts; he admits he wrongly believed lateral flexion was dangerous (I was WRONG about these lifts, 2023-12; BACK 2 THE GYM STREAM (Program reviews & Answering training questions), 2024-09).
  • Push/pull balance reversed. 2020: do more pulling than pushing (Upper Lower 2 days Program review, 2020-05). 2024: many reviewees are back-dominant from "pull twice as much as you push" advice and need more front volume (Do you look better than Silver Era lifters? (Physique Review LIVE), 2024-12; So you think you look good? (Physique Critique Chad Edition), 2024-12).
  • Traps: massive NO → little direct work. 2020: about 150 shrugs after every pull and the shrug-finisher rule (Nucleus overload guide (part. 3)： my experience & sports applications, 2020-06; Weak point Wednesday： Trapezius, 2020-04). 2023-2024: RDLs cover the traps; shrugs are redundant free volume (Everything I do to get HUGE (Split, Reps, Lifts), 2023-09; 1st Natural Hypertrophy stream! ASK YOUR QUESTIONS AND I SHALL ANSWER, 2024-09).
  • Neck frequency. 2020: daily NO, then 3x/week (Nucleus overload guide (part. 3)： my experience & sports applications, 2020-06; Weak point Wednesday： Neck, 2020-09). 2024: 1-2x/week is enough and more than 3-4 is pointless (BACK 2 THE GYM STREAM (Program reviews & Answering training questions), 2024-09). Neck reps went from 8-15 to 10-20 (Nucleus overload guide (part. 4)： Reps, sets and frequency schemes, 2020-10; So you think you can lift? (Program Review LIVE), 2024-11).
  • Forearm frequency: cautious → "spam them". 2020: daily forearm NO is risky; start 1x/week (Hypertrophy Q&A #1, 2020-09; 3 days Upper 2 days Lower program review (for an advanced calisthenics guy part., 2020-11). 2023-2024: train like a maniac several times a week, 3-4x/week (SAVAGE PUSH DAY 🔥 (Hypertrophy Log #3), 2023-07; So you think you can lift? (Program Review LIVE), 2024-11; BACK 2 THE GYM STREAM (Program reviews & Answering training questions), 2024-09).
  • Lateral raise frequency. 2021-2022: up to 4-5x/week, wherever recoverable (Hypertrophy Q&A #8, 2021-09; Hypertrophy Q&A #9, 2022-01). 2024: once a week; 2-3x hinders progress (Your lifting program SUCKS! (Hypertrophy Q&A / Program review), 2024-10).
  • Biceps intensity floor. 2020-2021: strict 3-7 and 3-6 reps (FREE 4 days Body Parts split for Intermediates, 2020-06; The Smartest Push Pull Legs Routine by Jeff Nippard review, 2021-06). 2023: never below 4-6; stretch curls at 10-15 for tendons and elbow pain (Everything I do to get HUGE (Split, Reps, Lifts), 2023-09; Everything I do to get HUGE (Split, Reps, Lifts), 2023-09).
  • Pullover reps. 2020: preferably 5-7 (Nucleus overload guide (part. 4)： Reps, sets and frequency schemes, 2020-10). 2024: 6-10 experienced, 8-12 novices (So you think you can lift? (Program Review LIVE), 2024-11).
  • Ribcage-expansion mechanism. 2021-2022: costal cartilage spreading (Top 3 most underrated exercises, 2021-07; Hypertrophy Q&A #10, 2022-06). 2024: intercostal muscle, which shrinks if you stop (1st Natural Hypertrophy stream! ASK YOUR QUESTIONS AND I SHALL ANSWER, 2024-09).
  • Front-delt isolation. 2021-2022: not needed after pressing (Jeff Nippard's Push Pull Legs program review, 2021-01). 2025: front raises are worthwhile free volume (10 years of lifting for this (Hypertrophy Log #10), 2025-01).
  • Calves heavy vs light. 2020: "don't train calves heavy" (6 days Body parts split program review, 2020-08). 2024: progressive overload on two loaded calf raises, with load as the key (So you think you look good? (Physique Critique Chad Edition), 2024-12; The ULTIMATE Cardio/Calves Exercises Tier-List, 2024-02).
  • Triceps isolation for beginners. In 2020 he grew his arms mostly with biceps work. In 2024 he regrets 7 years without triceps isolation and says beginners should isolate every muscle from the start (The WORST Bodybuilding Program Ever Created (my bad), 2024-04).

Contradictions

  • Lower back isolation. "Deadlifts alone are not enough for the lower back; like the core it needs isolating" (Tips to combat lower back pain #1, 2020-02) vs. the lower back rarely needs dedicated work; stabilization in squats and pulls is enough (Using the lower back as a bridge (the new lift with your legs), 2020-12; Level up your back, 2022-02). Both are 2020, and the latter was restated in 2022.
  • Rear delt volume (2020). "You can never do enough rear delt work" (5 days Upper Lower program review (Week 2), 2020-08) vs. rear delts have "a striking diminishing return" and need little work (2 days Upper (Torso/Arm dominant) split program review, 2020-04; 5 days Upper Lower program review (part. 2), 2020-10).
  • Calf loading (2020). "Don't train calves heavy" (6 days Body parts split program review, 2020-08) vs. a heavy calf day and loaded stretches (Weak point Wednesday： Calves, 2020-05; Is there a natural limit?, 2020-09).
  • Side bends (2023). Barbell and dumbbell side bends train the obliques poorly (The ULTIMATE Abs Exercises Tier-List (Greek God-tier to Scrawny-tier), 2023-06) vs. side bends are S-tier with full range (I was WRONG about these lifts, 2023-12). The difference may be full range on a hyperextension bench, which he used in 2024 (BACK 2 THE GYM STREAM (Program reviews & Answering training questions), 2024-09).
  • Long-head triceps reps (2023). It "responds best to higher reps and endurance" (The Monster Natty that trains EVERY DAY (Geoffrey Verity Schofield), 2023-04) vs. it fatigues faster than the biceps, so use 6-12 (We're turning Alan Thrall into a bodybuilder!, 2023-05).
  • Abs heavy (2022 vs 2023-2024). A plate for 5-10 reps is a "powerlifting mindset" (READ THE F＊CKING STICKY - The Best Lifting Advice on 4chan /fit/ (Myths & Minds, 2022-01) vs. weighted sit-ups at 6-12 and 6-10 (Heavy Duty Arm Day (Hypertrophy Log #1), 2023-07; So you think you can lift? (Program Review LIVE), 2024-11). This is partly the evolution above.
  • Neck directions. Train every direction (Most UNDERRATED Muscle for Aesthetics (TAKE THE NECK PILL), 2022-11; Nucleus overload guide (part. 4)： Reps, sets and frequency schemes, 2020-10) vs. he never trains side flexion and says rotation only matters for athletes (So you think you can lift? (Program Review LIVE), 2024-11).
  • Cheat curls (2020-2021). A staple that built his biceps (100 lbs (45 kg) cheat curls for 4, 2020-04; STORY TIME： My entire training history, 2021-08) vs. heavy EZ cheat curls are "not the way to big arms" (Limb dominant vs Torso dominant： does it matter?, 2020-07).
  • Ab placement (2020). Ab isolation belongs on upper days while fresh, though he trains abs on lower days himself (5 days Upper Lower program review (part. 2), 2020-10). In 2022 he puts abs after the lower compounds (Silver Era Aesthetics Program (Steve Reeves Physique Workout), 2022-10).
  • Fat grips. He knows no one who built big forearms with them (Fat grips training for forearm hypertrophy, 2020-03) vs. towels and fat grips grew his forearms best (3 YEAR RECOMP TRANSFORMATION (From Husky to Jacked) - 50K SPECIAL, 2022-08).

Natural vs enhanced

Changed over time

  • Weight of hormones for naturals. In 2020 the hormonal profile "matters". He called it the biggest genetic factor for naturals, said small edges compound, and recommended heavy squats and deadlifts partly for their acute T/GH boost (Improving your hormonal profile naturally： train hard & frequently, 2020-03; Improving your hormonal profile naturally： train hard & frequently, 2020-03; Why your Genetics don't matter, 2020-12). From 2022, normal or slightly low levels are "almost irrelevant", low T doesn't stop progress, the T obsession was imported from PED users, and you shouldn't get tested (To Vitruvian Physique： Don't do it, bro, 2022-10; YES, You ARE a Better Person if You Stay NATURAL! (Response to Revival Fitness), 2022-01; To Vitruvian Physique： Don't do it, bro, 2022-10). The later view is the de-emphasis.
  • Androgen-sensitive muscles as tells. In 2020 he called upper chest, traps, shoulders and upper back "the most suspicious muscles" and giveaways (How to spot a fake natty： inability to explain muscle size, 2020-02; Weak point Wednesday： Trapezius, 2020-04). In 2021 he said they "are not signs of steroids; naturals can develop any muscle" (Natty or not (.com)： Omar Isuf, 2021-06). In 2023-2024 he treated them as weak evidence weighed with overall development (overgrown traps and delts vs clear lagging areas) (The Natty Arnold? (Joel Kellett aka Overkell), 2023-07; Do you look better than Silver Era lifters? (Physique Review LIVE), 2024-12). Later view: weak evidence at most.
  • Spotting fakes vs dismissing natty-or-not. In 2020 he made sign-based content ("in most cases there are visible signs") (The training principles series： natty lifting, 2020-01; How to spot a fake natty： suspicious muscular rendering & general complexion nas, 2020-11). From 2021 he called natty-or-not content harmful, a waste of life, and free publicity for fakes (Natty or not (.com)： Omar Isuf, 2021-06; Jeff Nippard is WRONG about Natty or Nots., 2023-08; 💉 Taking steroids is cheating ｜ Natural Bodybuilder Reacts 💪, 2025-01). He still analyzed individuals in 2023-2024 (The Natty Arnold? (Joel Kellett aka Overkell), 2023-07).
  • Framing the steroid debate. In 2021 he called PED use "cheating, though in pro sports it may not be bad" (Natural Bodybuilding is dead, but we can revive it, 2021-02). By 2022-2025 the debate is about danger and facts, and calling it cheating is a strawman (⚰️Putting the FINAL Nail in the Coffin and Laying PED Fanboys to Rest for GO, 2022-01; 💉 Taking steroids is cheating ｜ Natural Bodybuilder Reacts 💪, 2025-01).
  • Attitude to users. In 2021 he had "no compassion" or pity for users who get sick (The many lies of PED users (part. 2), 2021-05; My opinion on Pro Bodybuilding, 2021-01). By 2023-2024 he felt pity, not hatred, aimed for empathy over insults, and called users "misguided", not bad people (What Would You Sacrifice for Gains? (An Essay on Ambition & Selfishness), 2023-09; 🍩 Is Being Fat a Choice? Bodybuilder Reacts 💪, 2024-05; I almost took steroids (Story Time), 2024-04).
  • State of natural bodybuilding. In 2021: "dead", with natural shows mostly not natural (Natural Bodybuilding is dead, but we can revive it, 2021-02; I might not be natural, 2021-08). From 2022 to 2025 it's a "noble natty" movement to build and sell on human potential (The 10 Commandments of Noble Natties, 2022-01; 10 Signs you might be a Blackpilled Natty, 2024-04; 💉 Taking steroids is cheating ｜ Natural Bodybuilder Reacts 💪, 2025-01).

Contradictions

  • Muscle memory. One 2020 video says lost size "comes back very fast" (Nether Beast Character Study： Staying on The Mark (13_22), 2020-10). Another 2020 video says that after 10 years and a full detrain it takes much longer than a year (How to spot a fake natty： rollercoaster progress, 2020-01). In 2024: naturals "regain it quickly" (Your lifting program SUCKS! (Hypertrophy Q&A / Program review), 2024-10).
  • Enhanced lifters' volume. "Enhanced and natural lifters' volumes are not very different" (Body parts split： bro split vs Gentleman Split, 2020-09), vs pros doing huge volume that exceeds natural work capacity (Good arm day Vs Bad arm day, 2021-01; Jeff Nippard & Alec Enkiri Want Me To Deload... I Don't Wanna (Size vs Strength , 2022-03), vs enhanced workouts being easy, with baby weights (How to spot a fake natty： their training is lazy and yet they grow, 2020-09; 💉 Taking steroids is cheating ｜ Natural Bodybuilder Reacts 💪, 2025-01). Coleman is an exception who "genuinely trained extremely hard" (Keep Ronnie Coleman's name out of your unworthy hardgainer's mouth, 2021-07).
  • Drug response. The hyper/non-responder idea is "exaggerated", and non-growers are lazy (The many lies of PED users (part. 1), 2021-05), vs response is unpredictable, some barely respond (Natty or not (.com)： Eric Bugenhagen, 2020-05), and some pros coast on an exceptional drug response (Do you look better than Silver Era lifters? (Physique Review LIVE), 2024-12).
  • Does a natural limit exist? "There is no such thing as a natural limit" (10 Year Natural Transformation 15-25 (from 110 to 210 lbs), 2020-04), vs natural limits as the body's "safeguards" (Sun and Steel： The Book That Changes Lives, 2023-12) and "the body has limits" (💉 Taking steroids is cheating ｜ Natural Bodybuilder Reacts 💪, 2025-01). Partly reconciled by his "chronological, not numerical" definition (Is there a natural limit?, 2020-09).
  • Advice from enhanced lifters. "Drug users give bad advice and cannot help naturals grow" (Fitness influencers are giving you body dysmorphia?! (Response to Geoffrey Verit, 2021-11), vs John Meadows "gave great advice" and honest users can be good role models (10 Signs you might be a Blackpilled Natty, 2024-04). Enhanced examples are a blackpill "even when the advice is good" (Judging and Grading every Fitness Channel (ⅠⅠⅠ： AthleanX, Kinobody, Scott , 2022-05).
  • Stigma vs empathy. Shaming saves lives, and refusing to stigmatize is cowardice (YES, You ARE a Better Person if You Stay NATURAL! (Response to Revival Fitness), 2022-01; 10 Signs you might be a Blackpilled Natty, 2024-04), vs dismissing users as stupid doesn't help, and he aims for empathy (What Would You Sacrifice for Gains? (An Essay on Ambition & Selfishness), 2023-09; 🍩 Is Being Fat a Choice? Bodybuilder Reacts 💪, 2024-05).
  • Naming names. In 2020 he said he will "never name anyone" or run a call-out channel (How to spot a fake natty： rollercoaster progress, 2020-01), yet he later named many alleged users (Fake Merc Character Study (part. 21)： Our bum Hemingway, 2022-07; Judging and Grading every Fitness Channel (VI： Liver King, Alex Eubank, Jujimufu, 2022-12).
  • PED myonuclei. PEDs "have been shown to increase myonuclei even without training", and regaining is slightly easier after use (Nucleus overload guide (part. 1)： What it is & how to implement it, 2020-05; Reasons to stay natural： you pay PED use with your lifespan, 2020-05), vs steroids don't give lasting muscle via myonuclei "in practice" (💉 Taking steroids is cheating ｜ Natural Bodybuilder Reacts 💪, 2025-01).

Nutrition

Changed over time

  • His own protein intake: 2020-11: 120-140 g/day (Nutrition Q&A #1, 2020-11). 2021-22: 50-70 g (Nutrition Q&A #2, 2021-04; Nutrition Q&A #3, 2022-03). 2024: back up to ~100-120 g (Everything I eat to get HUGE (Full Bulking Plan), 2024-03; Do you look better than Silver Era lifters? (Physique Review LIVE), 2024-12). Throughout he says high protein is unnecessary; the later figure is ~100-120 g.
  • Animal products' share: 2020-04: calories come "largely from animal products" (My diet for Natural Hypertrophy, 2020-04). From 2022: mostly carbs and plants, modest animal protein (🥐 My New Diet for Natural Hypertrophy 🍖 (Vegan? Meat only?), 2022-07; Full Day of Eating (Lean Bulk), 2023-10); 2024: meat ≤1x/day (1st Natural Hypertrophy stream! ASK YOUR QUESTIONS AND I SHALL ANSWER, 2024-09).
  • Red meat: 1 lb/week (2020) (My diet for Natural Hypertrophy, 2020-04) → beef eliminated (2022) (🥐 My New Diet for Natural Hypertrophy 🍖 (Vegan? Meat only?), 2022-07) → beef ~every two months (2024) (1st Natural Hypertrophy stream! ASK YOUR QUESTIONS AND I SHALL ANSWER, 2024-09).
  • Eggs: 12/day in his early bulks (My Nightmare Bulk (Story Time), 2023-09) → 4-8/week (2020) (My diet for Natural Hypertrophy, 2020-04) → 4-6/week (2024) (Everything I eat to get HUGE (Full Bulking Plan), 2024-03).
  • Dairy: first milk only (2020; he still liked goat cheese) (My diet for Natural Hypertrophy, 2020-04). Then cow and goat cheese went too, over two years (2022) (🥐 My New Diet for Natural Hypertrophy 🍖 (Vegan? Meat only?), 2022-07). Butter 1-2x/wk is the only dairy left (2024) (Everything I eat to get HUGE (Full Bulking Plan), 2024-03).
  • Sugar: 2021 he restricted sugars except fruit (The Best/Worst of Reddit Fitness - The Ten Commandments of Lifting, 2021-10); 2023-24 he eats a sweet croissant breakfast and calls banning sugar too extreme (Full Day of Eating (Lean Bulk), 2023-10; Everything I eat to get HUGE (Full Bulking Plan), 2024-03).
  • Pre-workout food: 2020 a pre-training meal "mostly psychological" (Can you modify the bodyfat range in which building muscle is most comfortable?, 2020-08); 2023-24 carb meal 2-3 h before, never train fasted (The Most IMPORTANT Methods for Muscle Growth (Hypertrophy Tier-List), 2023-11; BACK 2 THE GYM STREAM (Program reviews & Answering training questions), 2024-09).
  • Training share vs diet: "at least 50%" (2020) (Supplements are (mostly) useless, 2020-06) → "80% or more" (2023) (Stop falling for these Ab Training Myths, 2023-03).
  • Meal prep: 2021 recipes say to batch-cook rice and keep it 7-15 days (Bodybuilding cuisine： Idiot proof fried rice recipe, 2021-05). By 2022 he doesn't meal prep (🥐 My New Diet for Natural Hypertrophy 🍖 (Vegan? Meat only?), 2022-07), and in 2024 he says weekly prep wasted food (Everything I eat to get HUGE (Full Bulking Plan), 2024-03).
  • Garlic dose: 3-6 cloves/day (2020) (Raw garlic for insane pumps & a stronger immune system, 2020-03) → 1-2 cloves every other day (2023, supplements file) (My Favorite ＂Anabolic Herbs＂ for Bodybuilding, 2023-05).

Contradictions

  • Which training day gets the most carbs. Lower-body days: 2021 (Nutrition Q&A #2, 2021-04) and 2023 (ginger on lower days "when he eats more carbs") (My Favorite ＂Anabolic Herbs＂ for Bodybuilding, 2023-05). Upper-body days: 2022 (Nutrition Q&A #3, 2022-03) and 2024 (Everything I eat to get HUGE (Full Bulking Plan), 2024-03). The 2024 version is the latest.
  • Surplus vs maintenance for gains. He says no muscle in a deficit and you must eat until the scale moves (Why teens SHOULDN'T cut, 2020-07; Ectomorphs can NEVER get buff, ripped & strong (Nattyornot.com), 2021-09), but also that maintenance is "all you need for gains" (Clean foods： illusion or reality?, 2021-01).
  • Intuitive eating. He recommends eating by instinct (Food insecurity/neurotic traits and dieting, 2020-06), yet says relying only on appetite during a recomp backfired on him (Recomp guide (part. 2)： Who can do it & diet manipulation, 2020-05).
  • Fried rice fridge life. 7-9 days (Bodybuilding cuisine： Idiot proof fried rice recipe, 2021-05) vs 10-15 days (Bodybuilding cuisine： Dummy proof vegetable medley recipe, 2021-08) (different dishes, both 2021).

Other

Contradictions

  • Grappling: he likes grappling above all and practised judo (2020) (Natural Q&A #2, 2020-09). In 2024 he advises avoiding ground arts like BJJ/judo for street self-defence (TIME TO GROW BOYS (Live Q&A / Self-Improvement), 2024-09). These are different contexts (preference vs street advice), so the conflict is mild.
  • Weights and fighting speed: he calls weights making fighters slow a myth (Bodybuilders can't FIGHT (but martial artists should lift), 2022-01), but in the same video says big enhanced bodybuilders are slow and gas out (Bodybuilders can't FIGHT (but martial artists should lift), 2022-01). The likely nuance is extreme size vs moderate lifting; he doesn't reconcile them explicitly.

Personal journey

Changed over time
